mechanisms.name: self-healing by directional Ti diffusion and eta-Ni3Ti precipitation at cavities

evidence.quote: The creep lifetimes of SHNi alloys are observed 8 – 10 times higher than that of nSHNi alloys. Microstructure characterizations have shown that η -Ni 3 Ti healing agents in SHNi alloys can form site-specifically at the cavity sites during service.

during the creep, the solid solutioned Ti atoms are driven to move toward the cavity surfaces by the chemical driving force, and herein nucleate as η-Ni3Ti healing precipitates. This directional diffusion will interrupt the transmission of vacancies towards the cavities
the solid solution strengthening of Ti atoms is the dominant hardening mechanism

mechanisms.name: stress-directed diffusive transport of vacancies to cavity surface

evidence.quote: The cavity growth occurs by the stress-directed diffusive transport of voids to the cavity surface. In the nSHNi alloy, the voids can move unimpededly towards the cavity surface, leading to the unconstrained growth of the cavities
